items.title: Clarence Ford Interview, 1975-12-10
items.q: He's playing with Papa French now.

ctx.x: Yeah, was that, when did you first start working with Dave Bartholomew?

First, I believe this was around, oh it was a little after 1950, it was before I went to Detroit. But after I left the Johnson Brothers, I went with Dave for a while, and when he worked at the Pelican on Rapport Street, he opened it up. And he was a very good trumpet player. At the time he was playing music. He had arraignments on everything. And he was a very good reader. He was making it strictly off his band and he worked six nights a week on his Johnson. Yeah, he had to do a hot band. And his band had good…
